title: 18th Sitting of third session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/18/3/2025).
Continuation of the debate on the proposed state budget for 2026, held under Rule 235 of the Parliament's Standing Orders.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was scheduled to continue the debate on the government's proposed 2026 state budget and then vote on anything ready for a decision.
